a: The fit guards measure every path's halo as half the halo width, so a stroke path's halo can leave the box unseen — and the marked crosshair's does
A marked glyph accepts an angle but is never checked for rotation, and the crosshair's marks fall outside the box when rotated
The bake cache's key takes any size and any fallback string, so it is unbounded despite its comment
The fit guards' path walk accepts absolute H, V, C, Q, S and T without throwing, and mis-measures H and V
The arc bound uses the authored radius even when SVG scales it up, under-reporting an arc whose radius is shorter than half its chord
markedGlyph drops a glyph's own `over` layer instead of keeping and shifting it
b: haloFitsInBox and rotationFitsInBox ignore a stroke path's own width, so a stroked glyph whose halo is clipped passes both guards
A marked glyph is baked rotated, but its mark sits outside the inscribed circle and loses its corners
The cursorFor cache claims a bounded key space, but `size` and `fallback` are free-form, so it grows without limit
A world-unit brush ring of radius 0 is drawn at the 24 px default, while a px ring of radius 0 is drawn at 1 px
walk() accepts absolute H, V, C, S, Q and T but reads them as x,y pairs, so the fit guards mis-measure instead of throwing
walk() bounds an arc whose radius is too small for its chord by the authored radius, not the radius SVG scales it up to
